title: Shellphone
description: A mod that adds Shellphone & Magic Mirror from Terraria to Minecraft
body:
# Shellphone Mod
The Shellphone Mod adds the Shellphone & Magic Mirror from Terraria onto Minecraft.

### 1. Magic Mirror
The Magic Mirror teleports you to your spawn point on use, and to the world spawn if you have no spawn points set, it is crafted with a Diamond Glass Shard surrounded by 8 Iron Ingots.

### 2. Magic Conch
The Magic Conch teleports you to your last death location on use, it is crafted with a Heart of the Sea Shard surrounded by 8 Shells. (not Nautilus Shells)

### 3. Shellphone
The Shellphone combines the functionality of the Magic Conch & Magic Mirror, and is crafted by those 2, you can toggle where it'll take you by using the item while crouched.

### 4. Shell
Crafted by a Nautilus Shell or found by fishing, used to craft the Magic Conch &  can craft Nautilus Shells. (9 Shells).

### 5. Diamond Glass Shard
Made by a Glass Shard surrounded by Diamonds, used to create the Magic Mirror.

### 6. Glass Shard
Obtained by breaking Fragile Glass, used to create Diamond Glass Shards.

### 7. Fragile Glass
Made by smelting Glass in a Furnace, can be broken to obtain 4 Glass Shards
